 around the work place.

Cleaning fluids such as Freon - TF

Power

Introduction
This 
 document describes the regular maintenance that has to be done for HRSG 
 ERV valve actuator and the interval of each item of 
 maintenance
The first draft is initiated by eng. Hany elokda, tested by eng. Bahaa abd 
 elwahab, revised by MDEPCo. Quality control eng. Adel El Naggar, accepted by 
 eng. Mohamed el sherif, general manager & eng. Samir Abd El Gillil MDEPCo. 
 quality control general director, approved by eng. Ahmed Sawwan head sector of 
 Nubaria PS and certified by eng. Mohammed Nageeb inspection and quality head 
 sector
Quantity | Manufacture | Tag Numbers | Type | Supply voltage | Service Description
16 | Limitork | HV340,HV602,V350,
 V605,...etc | L120-85 multi turn actuator | 380 V AC | Steam lines
Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be issued
Personal protective equipment must be used (safety shoes, 
 Helmet, breathing mask, safety glasses)
Maintenance staff should be well trained and qualified.
Caution marks must be hanged on the work place, safety rope 
 around the work place.
Tools 
and Equipment
Brushes
AVO meter
Blower
Cleaning fluids such as Freon - TF 
 chlorothene
Allen key
Screws
Work to be 
carried out
Inspection and 
maintenance of pneumatic control valve positioned
Check the supply voltage (380 V AC)
Check the feed back and command signal
Check opening and close the valve
Actuator cleaning
Close the work permit
